ut-diabetic-foot.l: Depth grade [0 = Pre-ulcerative or post-ulcerative lesion, completely epithelialized; I = Superficial ulcer, not involving tendon, capsule or bone; II = Ulcer penetrating to tendon or capsule, without palpable bone; III = Ulcer probing to bone]. Grade 0 is a pre- or post-ulcerative epithelialized lesion, NOT "no problem".
Complication stage [A = No infection and no ischemia; B = Infection - cellulitis, abscess or osteomyelitis; C = Ischemia; D = Both infection and ischemia]. This is the axis depth cannot see.

uterine-activity.l: Contractions in one 10-minute window (for Montevideo units)
